## Language

{{< include /components/_lang.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
// Per-locale notebook text: same key tree per language, missing keys fall back to English.
// Both locales are fetched ONCE here (no `language` dependency) so toggling the
// language never hits the network — nbText is a pure lookup.
nbTextAll = {
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([
    FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/en.json").json(),
    FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/fr.json").json(),
  ]);
  return { en, fr: Lang.withFallback(fr, en) };
}

nbText = nbTextAll[language.key] ?? nbTextAll.en

nbTitle = nbText.meta.title

// Narrative prose: one file per block (data/cis/text/<id>.<locale>.md), `title:`
// front matter + markdown body. The block id is the filename — the CMS
// (admin/config.yml) edits these; scripts/build/cmsContent.lua bakes English in
// at render. FileAttachment paths must be literal, hence the explicit map.
proseFiles = new Object({
  "overview": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/overview.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/overview.fr.md") },
  "weather-measurement": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-measurement.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-measurement.fr.md") },
  "weather-consistency": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-consistency.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-consistency.fr.md") },
  "forecast-reliability": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/forecast-reliability.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/forecast-reliability.fr.md") },
  "readiness-index": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/readiness-index.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/readiness-index.fr.md") },
  "hazard-intersection": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/hazard-intersection.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/hazard-intersection.fr.md") },
  "reach-at-scale": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/reach-at-scale.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/reach-at-scale.fr.md") },
  "methods": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methods.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methods.fr.md") },
  "data-sources": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/data-sources.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/data-sources.fr.md") },
  "methodology": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methodology.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methodology.fr.md") },
  "acknowledgements": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/acknowledgements.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/acknowledgements.fr.md") },
})

// All block files load in parallel at page start (they don't block first paint —
// English is baked in by cmsContent.lua); the toggle is a plain lookup.
sectionsAll = {
  const load = (loc) =>
    Promise.all(
      Object.entries(proseFiles).map(async ([id, files]) => [
        id,
        Lang.parseBlock(await (files[loc] ?? files.en).text()),
      ]),
    ).then(Object.fromEntries);
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([load("en"), load("fr")]);
  return { en, fr };
}

sections = sectionsAll[language.key] ?? sectionsAll.en

// languages / langKey / language / _lang come from /components/_lang.qmd,
// included above with the notebook text cells.
```

## Admin selectors

```{ojs}
// One canonical selector configuration, used for the master and every display.
// The component owns its own label translations, cascade invalidation, search and
// bulk actions (helpers/adminSelectors.ojs).
adminSelectorConfig = ({
  levels: [0, 1, 2],
  multiple: true,
  language: language.key,
  selectAll: true,
})

// MASTER ADMIN SELECTION for the whole notebook. It lives in this hidden
// appendix section and is never interacted with directly; each section renders
// its own copy bound to it, so every display stays in sync.
viewof adminSelection = createAdminSelectors(adminSelectorConfig)

// Sections call this for their own visible, synchronized copy.
adminSelectorDisplay = () =>
  Inputs.bind(createAdminSelectors(adminSelectorConfig), viewof adminSelection)

// Downstream code works in plain admin names at whichever level is selected.
selectedAdmin0 = adminSelection.admin0.map((d) => d.admin0_name);
selectedAdmin1 = adminSelection.admin1.map((d) => d.admin1_name);
selectedAdmin2 = adminSelection.admin2.map((d) => d.admin2_name);
```

## Boundaries

```{ojs}
import { getAdminBoundaries } from "/components/_atlasBoundaries.ojs";

// Levels 0 and 1 are small (14 KB and 48 KB over the wire) and always drawn.
atlasBoundaries = await getAdminBoundaries([0, 1]);

admin0Boundaries = atlasBoundaries.admin0;
admin1Boundaries = atlasBoundaries.admin1;

// Admin 2 is 336 KB over the wire and 6670 geometries to parse, and nothing
// draws it until a region is selected (currentAdminLevel === 2). Load it on
// first use and hold the promise, so the parse happens at most once per session
// however often the reader moves in and out of district view.
loadAdmin2Boundaries = {
  let pending = null;
  return () => (pending ??= getAdminBoundaries(2).then((b) => b.admin2));
}

admin2Boundaries = currentAdminLevel === 2 ? await loadAdmin2Boundaries() : null;

// The boundary set for whichever level the current selection implies. Every map
// in every section wants this, so it is derived once here.
currentBoundaries =
  currentAdminLevel === 2
    ? admin2Boundaries
    : currentAdminLevel === 1
      ? admin1Boundaries
      : admin0Boundaries;

// Whether a boundary feature falls inside the current admin selection, by name.
// At admin 0 the whole map is in scope; deeper levels narrow to the selected
// names, and an empty selection at a level means "all of it".
// Sets, not the arrays: this runs per boundary feature, and admin 1 can hold 550+
// selections, so `includes` was a linear scan inside a 4000-feature filter.
selectedAdmin0Set = new Set(selectedAdmin0)

selectedAdmin1Set = new Set(selectedAdmin1)

inCurrentSelection = (properties) => {
  if (currentAdminLevel === 0) return true;

  const inAdmin0 =
    selectedAdmin0Set.size === 0 ||
    selectedAdmin0Set.has(properties.admin0_name);
  if (currentAdminLevel === 1) return inAdmin0;

  return (
    inAdmin0 &&
    (selectedAdmin1Set.size === 0 ||
      selectedAdmin1Set.has(properties.admin1_name))
  );
};

// Every map outlines the districts the reader picked the same way.
adminHighlight = ({
  filter: (d) => d.properties.isHighlighted,
  stroke: "#000",
  strokeWidth: 2.5,
})

// Null-safe fixed-point formatting for tables, tooltips and CSV exports.
fmt = (value, decimals = 3) =>
  value == null || Number.isNaN(Number(value))
    ? "N/A"
    : Number(value).toFixed(decimals)

// Display name for a row at the current admin level, for tables and CSV exports.
// Deliberately shorter than the maps' regionName, which also appends the country
// at admin 2.
adminDisplayName = (d) =>
  currentAdminLevel === 0
    ? d.admin0_name
    : currentAdminLevel === 1
      ? `${d.admin1_name}, ${d.admin0_name}`
      : `${d.admin2_name}, ${d.admin1_name}`;
```
